shadows.name: prompt-lift

components.name: Shaping Prompt
components.description: The centered composer that becomes the stable conversation dock.
components.css: .ds-shaping-prompt { width: min(760px, 100%); padding: 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface, oklch(0.165 0.006 340)); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.955 0.006 340)); transition: box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-shaping-prompt:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 -1px var(--flect-rose, oklch(0.630 0.180 340)), 0 6px 8px oklch(0.02 0 0 / 0.24); } .ds-shaping-prompt textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 72px; resize: none; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; } .ds-prompt-rail { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-prompt-rail button { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.205 0.008 340); color: inherit; } .ds-prompt-rail button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.630 0.180 340); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Circular submit control for the shaping prompt.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.955 0.006 340); color: oklch(0.095 0 0); font: 600 18px/1 system-ui; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: oklch(0.690 0.170 340); color: oklch(0.955 0.006 340); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.630 0.180 340); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Control
components.css: .ds-ghost-control { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.690 0.012 340); font: 520 13px/1 system-ui; } .ds-ghost-control:hover { background: oklch(0.205 0.008 340); color: oklch(0.955 0.006 340); } .ds-ghost-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.630 0.180 340); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A black anodized working surface with one restrained rose signal. The shell recedes so the person's intent and the interface being shaped remain central.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Flect Rose occupies less than ten percent of a screen.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Active Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use tone; elevation communicates active hierarchy.

dos: Do keep the person's work and prompt visually central.
Do keep safe mode independently reachable.
donts: Don't turn Flect into a fixed widget dashboard.
Don't present the agent as a chatbot bolted onto a static application.
Don't use terminal cosplay, neon gradients, decorative glass, or loud AI activity chrome.
